info.title: Twilio - Api
info.description: This is the public Twilio REST API.

get.summary: Retrieves a collection of calls made to and from your account
get.description: Retrieves a collection of calls made to and from your account

parameters.name: AccountSid
parameters.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Call resource(s) to read.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Only show calls made to this phone number, SIP address, Client identifier or SIM SID.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Only include calls from this phone number, SIP address, Client identifier or SIM SID.

parameters.name: ParentCallSid
parameters.description: Only include calls spawned by calls with this SID.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the calls to include. Can be: `queued`, `ringing`, `in-progress`, `canceled`, `completed`, `failed`, `busy`, or `no-answer`.

schema.description: The status of this call. Can be: `queued`, `ringing`, `in-progress`, `canceled`, `completed`, `failed`, `busy` or `no-answer`. See [Call Status Values](https://www.twilio.com/docs/

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Only include calls that started on this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that started on this date.

parameters.name: StartTime<
parameters.description: Only include calls that started before this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that started before this date.

parameters.name: StartTime>
parameters.description: Only include calls that started on or after this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that started on or after this date.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: Only include calls that ended on this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that ended on this date.

parameters.name: EndTime<
parameters.description: Only include calls that ended before this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that ended before this date.

parameters.name: EndTime>
parameters.description: Only include calls that ended on or after this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that ended on or after this date.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

parameters.name: PageToken
parameters.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

group_sid.description: The Group SID associated with this call. If no Group is associated with the call, the field is empty.

parent_call_sid.description: The SID that identifies the call that created this leg.

from_formatted.description: The calling phone number, SIP address, or Client identifier formatted for display. Non-North American phone numbers are in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) f
